title: Senior AI Search Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Focuses on search relevance: semantic retrieval, cross-encoder re-ranking and RAG applications in LangGraph, with hands-on Apache Solr, Lucene indexing and Elasticsearch, delivered as REST APIs on FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes. Turns user needs into technical approaches together with product and platform teams. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Hybrid Catalog Search Service
bullets: Built a hybrid search service for ecommerce product catalogs, blending Elasticsearch keyword matching with vector retrieval and query understanding for natural-language shopper queries.
Measured relevance with offline judgment sets and NDCG across keyword and hybrid modes, added cross-encoder re-ranking on top, and served the search API through FastAPI on Kubernetes.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior AI Search Engineer role on your Discovery Team in Munich. Much of my recent work has been about retrieval: re-ranking dense results with a fine-tuned cross-encoder, building RAG assistants over large document sets, and keeping those systems healthy in production. Helping people find what they mean, not only what they type, runs through all of it.

commercetools powers the commerce layer behind large brands, and taking semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability while queries turn into sentences and agents is the kind of problem I want to spend the next years on. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Munich together and settle there long term.

I would bring practical relevance work to the team. At United Health Group I fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs to re-rank dense retrieval, and at Viavi I built a LangGraph discovery assistant with a 90% match rate against existing solutions. I also enjoy the serving side, with FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to build for real users and to check carefully whether a feature actually helps. I would be glad to talk about the Discovery Team's plans for hybrid retrieval.
